phrases.partly_afternoon: Patches of cloud cross the sky above the Arc de Triomphe, seen from the rooftop dining table this afternoon.

phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds pass over Copacabana this afternoon, and swimmers in the rooftop pool watch their shadows move across the beach.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken clouds over Sugarloaf catch warm light, best seen from the terrace loungers.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the ocean looks grey too, but the soaking tub beside the bathroom window still works perfectly.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on Copacabana today, and guests watch the grey ocean from behind the floor-to-ceiling windows of their rooms.

phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is short today; the Atlantic coastline is not in sight from the eastern viewpoint, though Malacara across the valley still is.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the outline of Osorno is already visible from every bedside through the floor-to-ceiling glass.
phrases.clear_morning: This morning the lake is calm, and guests at breakfast in the AWA Restaurant see the snow-capped cone of Osorno clearly.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the glazed pool is bright on both walls and overhead, with Lake Llanquihue flat and blue beyond.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun crosses Lake Llanquihue and reaches the private jetty, with the volcano sharp from all 25 rooms.
phrases.clear_night: If you were in a room tonight, you would see stars over the lake through glass running from bedside to horizon.
phrases.partly_morning: Scattered clouds sit over the lake this morning, but the cone of Osorno is still framed in the circular porthole window.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon clouds pass above Lake Llanquihue, and swimmers in the glass-enclosed pool watch them through the ceiling.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken clouds take colour over the water, visible from the bar at ground level.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey ceiling of cloud, Osorno is hidden today, though the lake stays visible from the restaurant tables.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Lake Llanquihue right now, and guests in the heated spa pool stay dry under its glass roof.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is crossing the lake, so the private beach is empty and guests watch from behind floor-to-ceiling glass.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog covers the lake this morning, and from the rooms neither Osorno nor the far shore can be seen.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling along the shoreline, and from the warm restaurant guests see the private jetty turning white.
phrases.very_cold: Outside it feels below zero today, and the snow cap of Osorno stands clear across the lake from every room.
phrases.very_hot: On this unusually hot day, the beach in front of the hotel is busy and the lake looks very inviting.
phrases.mild_night: The night is mild and cloudy, so guests on the ground floor hear the lake more than they see it.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low over the lake today, so Osorno cannot be seen, only the water near the private beach.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the balcony rooms look onto a dark, flat Canandaigua Lake, with no boats out yet.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning yoga is underway behind the open glass doors, and the lake outside is bright and completely calm.
phrases.clear_midday: At midday the floor-to-ceiling lounge windows frame treetops in full sun, and the lake beyond shows a few small boats.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun reaches the Adirondack chairs on the lawn, and from the balconies the far shore looks sharp and warm.
phrases.clear_night: Inside a cedar barrel sauna tonight, the glass end shows the whole dark lake under a clear sky.
phrases.partly_morning: From a balcony this morning, scattered clouds move over Canandaigua Lake while one early boat crosses the water below.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds pass over the lake this afternoon, and guests in the lounge watch the light change through the tall windows.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken clouds color over the lake, best seen from the Adirondack chairs on the lawn.
phrases.overcast: A grey sky sits over Canandaigua Lake today, but yoga continues behind the glass doors facing the water.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the lake, and the greenhouse at Rose Tavern stays dry while dinner leaves the wood-fired hearth.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is crossing the lake, and guests watch it from the lounge behind floor-to-ceiling windows, dinner still warm.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog covers most of Canandaigua Lake this morning, so the balconies show grey water close by and little else.
phrases.snow: Snow covers the grounds, the fire pit is lit by the shoreline saunas, and the outdoor pool is steaming.
phrases.very_cold: Outside it is below freezing, yet guests sit in the heated outdoor pool watching steam rise over the snowy lakefront.
phrases.very_hot: On a very hot afternoon, the balcony rooms catch whatever breeze crosses the lake, and the dock below stays busy.
phrases.mild_night: A mild, cloudy night sits over the lake, and the greenhouse at Rose Tavern glows with lights from the hearth.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so the far shore cannot be seen from the balconies, only the nearest stretch of water.
